scope.inputs: Frozen outputs/* and matching packets/* only; canonical registry/compiler/runtime executor checked for feasibility.

reported_failures.tool: apply_generated_buff_on_use omits required lightStrength and lightColor
reported_failures.musket: bounceCount omitted for root and child collision calls

engine_constraints: configure_tool executes mining on primary_use spawn_entity or use_item_body actions; the spawned projectile itself does not mine.

A named apply_generated_buff_on_use group with a matching refresh_generated_effect_group_while_held bypasses the apply_item_effects binding requirement; held refresh applies the generated buff group every held tick.
item_body.on_use is emitted for every accepted non-placement primary_use/alternate_use. spawn_entity_on_event offers no per-input filter, so its effect cannot be limited to one active input.

target_and_fire supports stationary_projectile and temporary_helper, sets velocity to zero, and its executor returns controllerOwnsMotion=true; GeneratedProjectile AI therefore skips RunMovement and modifiers for that update. Coauthored move_orbit does not execute alongside it. A target_and_fire entity cannot simultaneously cursor/tether-hover through movement.

primary_mining.execution: configure_tool supports primary spawn_entity; program-level rejection is due to the generated buff call missing required lightStrength/lightColor.

primary_straight_shot.execution: Straight shot has its own free_projectile target; tool power is on item_body.

alternate_only_boomerang.execution: on_use producer fires for both primary and alternate; concept explicitly admits returner also fires on primary.

held_ore_and_regeneration_refresh.execution: Correct named-group/held-refresh topology and intended effects, but program is invalid because required lightStrength and lightColor are absent from held_prospector_group.

primary_mining.execution: Primary spawn_entity activates native tool powers; 100 pick power and 1.2 mining-speed divisor are explicit.

alternate_only_boomerang.execution: Shared item_body.on_use also spawns the blade on primary; concept acknowledges this. No input-scoped event selector exists.

held_ore_and_regeneration_refresh.execution: Named group has explicit lightStrength=0/lightColor=gray, oreSenseEnabled=true, lifeRegenHpPerSecond=1, and matching held refresh.

alternate_only_boomerang.execution: Alternate binding directly targets returning_shard; unlike the shared on_use variants, no primary path references it.

held_ore_and_regeneration_refresh.execution: Valid named effect group plus matching held refresh; no apply_item_effects binding is required for this held-only group.

native_fallen_star_consumption.execution: Uses configure_weapon_ammo, not configure_vanilla_ammo_item; program is blocked by missing bounceCount on root and child collision calls.

child_homing.execution: Applied to child target; its event producer is authored.

Native ammo category fallen_star is selected with native_shot speed basis; this is ammo consumption, not marking the gun as ammunition.

on_hit_child_spawn.execution: Verified in full frozen file; root on_hit references homing_star_child.

trap.packetBrief: Primary active hovering trap fires separate straight damaging darts at nearby enemies; alternate use places exact native gray pressure plate (tile 135, style 2); placed tile is not a turret.
trap.feasibility: Exact combination of cursor/tether movement plus target_and_fire on the same entity is not executable: target_and_fire returns controllerOwnsMotion=true and skips RunMovement, so it holds the entity at its spawn position. Alternatives are (a) cursor/tether movement with periodic event shots, optionally homing darts instead of straight darts, or (b) a position-owning stationary/helper target_and_fire turret that fires authored shots without tether movement. Do not score either alternative as a simple loss of the other function.

hovering_tethered_trap.execution: owner_attached_projectile, channel=true, yoyo hover follows cursor within authored leash and returns on release.

periodic_straight_darts.execution: periodic 0.5-second event emits separate facing-aimed straight darts.

nearby_enemy_targeting.execution: No target acquisition is authored. Adding target_and_fire would own the source entity's movement and suppress yoyo tether; homing the dart would change it from straight motion.

exact_gray_pressure_plate_placement.execution: Alternate use references tileId=135, placeStyle=2; distinct from active trap.

hovering_tethered_trap.execution: channel=true and yoyo hover target retain cursor leash/return.

periodic_straight_darts.execution: Periodic event and straight movement are authored, but same guided_dart also has dart_targeting: move_slow_homing; movement calls share exclusive movement group, so output is invalid.

nearby_enemy_targeting.execution: Homing alone is a supported alternative on the child, but cannot coexist with the requested straight driver; no trap controller target selection.

hovering_tethered_trap.execution: Executor zeros velocity and skips movement whenever target_and_fire owns controller dispatch; coauthored move_orbit does not execute. Result is a stationary helper, not an orbiting/tethered trap.

periodic_straight_darts.execution: Controller acquires an eligible NPC and spawns the separate straight-moving trap_dart at its authored interval.

nearby_enemy_targeting.execution: temporary_helper is an allowed kind; explicit 12-tile hard range and LOS; firing works, while helper stays at spawn point.

limitations: This is a four-case stress review, not a benchmark or estimate of model quality.
Statuses describe the authored frozen runtimeProgram plus canonical mechanics; when programValid=false, otherwise-preserved calls cannot execute until the separate validation failure is repaired.

The brief's trap conjunction of tether-hover and automatic target_and_fire cannot be achieved on one entity under the present executor. The observed arms choose different supported sides of that constraint.
